title: Machine manifest
description: What dotfiles_configurator apply records about this machine, for the tools that read it.

EstateName.description: The name of an estate, which also names its directory: letters, digits, '-' and '_' alone.

Estates.description: Each estate on this machine and the owners it groups. An estate is named once, lists an owner once, and an owner belongs to one estate.

MachineClass.description: The class of machine the run that wrote this manifest applied.

configuration_sources.description: The configuration sources the run that wrote this manifest was given, as it was given them.

Owner.description: An account or organisation that owns repositories on GitHub, compared without regard to case.

RepositoriesDirectory.description: The directory this machine's class of repositories is cloned into, rooted at a filesystem root; the directory above it is where discovery starts.

SlotsPerBank.description: How many session slots one bank of this machine's screen holds.
